agents.prompt_summary: Use the zodiac label as doorway only; the visual format is lived scenes, not astrology graphics.
Every slide has an object receipt: keys, phone, checklist, bracelet/sleeve, maps, lights, closed notebook.
Track eye-lines, hands, distance, and the joke-to-tenderness turn.
Preserve exact multiline text in upper-middle warm negative space for both native formats.
Attach selected identity bundle plus identity-face contact sheet before generation.
Reject quote-card astrology, generic sign symbols, passive Zuv, and chaos-as-mockery.
